Home Décor Pastel Blue Vase Large

Bring a soft and serene charm to your interiors with the Pastel Blue Vase – Large. Designed with a modern yet timeless aesthetic, this vase features a smooth pastel blue finish that instantly uplifts any space with its calming hue. Its tall, elegant silhouette makes it perfect for displaying long-stemmed flowers, dried arrangements, or simply as a standalone decorative accent. Whether styled on a console, dining table, or shelf, this vase adds a refreshing pop of color while blending seamlessly with contemporary, Scandinavian, or coastal-inspired décor themes. Elevate your living space with the tranquil beauty of the Pastel Blue Vase – Large. With its soft, powdery blue hue and graceful silhouette, this vase embodies understated elegance and modern simplicity. Its generous height and clean form make it the perfect statement piece for any interior, whether styled as a striking centerpiece or placed on a console, sideboard, or mantel to add a touch of calm sophistication. Crafted from high-quality ceramic/stoneware, the vase features a smooth, refined finish that feels luxurious to the touch while ensuring durability for everyday use. Its wide opening allows for versatile arrangements—from fresh flowers and long-stemmed botanicals to dried branches or decorative pampas grass. Even when left empty, the vase’s pastel blue tone adds a refreshing pop of color to contemporary, Scandinavian, and coastal-inspired décor styles alike. Perfect for those who appreciate timeless design with a serene color palette, the Pastel Blue Vase – Large effortlessly transforms any corner of your home into a more inviting and stylish space.

Features

  • Elegant Design: Tall, sleek form in a soothing pastel blue shade.
  • Generous Size: Large enough to make a statement on tables, mantels, or sideboards.
  • Versatile Use: Perfect for fresh flowers, dried botanicals, or as a standalone accent piece.
  • Premium Finish: Smooth, glossy texture for a modern, refined look.
  • Durable Material: Crafted from high-quality ceramic/stoneware (depending on the manufacturer) for long-lasting use.
  • Easy Styling: Complements a variety of décor styles—modern, minimal, coastal, and more.
  • Low Maintenance: Wipe clean with a soft cloth to keep its fresh look.
  • Great Gift Idea: Ideal for Home Décor, weddings, or décor enthusiasts.
  • MOQ- 40Pc.
